limits: Synchronous dispatch and later callbacks/long tasks overlap; do not sum their durations.
Two-rAF and frame gaps are scheduling proxies, not physical presentation or field INP.
Point-sampled native Canvas and React attribution is approximate; timing includes automation/profiling overhead.
Two observations are diagnostics, not population percentiles or a causal regression claim for an isolated outlier.
Prepared-state waits are distinct from first saved graph visibility and retained-tab navigation.
Native metric rings can evict; no complete child-worker CPU attribution or absence-of-work claim follows from missing records.
Ordinary desktop background activity is not controlled.
Required TUI/browser journeys use installed real tools and scripted/inert fixtures; no live-model, cold-install or new proof claim.
